CHS eliminates the challenges of traditional methods. Avoid Downtime & Testing Delays IT teams spend hours testing hardening policies in lab environments to prevent downtime and misconfigurations. Manual processes slow security deployment and increase operational costs. CHS eliminates this by analyzing policy impact directly in production, ensuring seamless enforcement without outages. Prevent Configuration Drift Frequent changes by privileged users cause security policies to drift, forcing IT teams to repeatedly reapply hardening settings. The CHS server hardening tools continuously enforce policies in real time, preventing unauthorized modifications and keeping servers secure without manual intervention. Isn't it time for a smarter approach? 👇 Why Choose CHS for Server Hardening? Smarter Server Hardening, Zero Downtime CHS automates server hardening, ensuring security without disruption. It enforces policies, prevents changes, provides compliance dashboards, and supports rollback. Reduces Costs CHS eliminates the cost of creating lab environments for simulating the impact of security policies on servers. With CHS, the impact is analyzed directly on the production environments. Prevents Downtime CHS predicts the impact of a policy on production servers. By visualizing the impact, CHS’s smart risk management determines the values that will or will not result in server outage when hardened. Ensures Cyber Resilience CHS enforces server security policies in real time, thus, ensuring that the servers are proactively protected. Empowers IT Teams Our 'Learning' mode simulates the policy impact on production and reports on what can be enforced without breaking server operation or applications. Capabilities of Our Server Hardening Tool AI-Powered Learning Mode for Risk-Free Hardening CHS’s intelligent ‘Learning’ mode ensures critical server functions remain unaffected by hardening policies, automatically detecting and marking exceptions. Impact Analysis and Policy Management with CHS CHS performs an automated impact analysis on production, ensuring zero server outages and no investment of your engineer’s time in testing. It enables a Sys Admin to learn one server and apply the policy to a group of identical servers, and aids in managing conflicts with Group Policy Objects (GPO). Ready to simplify compliance?
